title: Canaries in the Gold Mine: Early Productivity Gains from Artificial Intelligence Creating Organization Capital
discussion_signal: The post frames early AI productivity gains as an organization-capital process: firms with AI-skilled workers may accumulate firm-specific knowledge through learning-by-doing, rather than gaining only from direct automation or tool access. The public translation therefore shifts attention from model capability to organizational absorption.
linked_research_question: Which industrial firms convert AI-skilled employment into durable organization capital, and which only accumulate tools without measurable productivity, worker, or consumer gains?
limits: The post summarizes research and does not independently measure firms
The linked research association may not identify a causal firm-level mechanism in every setting
Selected LinkedIn discussion cannot establish prevalence or implementation quality
